description: Create a freelance time tracking spreadsheet from scattered logs. Open /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/freelance_timesheet_dec.xlsx and /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/time_logs.txt (reference). Enter all 14 time entries with columns: Date, Client Name, Project Code, Hours Worked, Hourly Rate, Amount (calculated), Notes. Create formulas for Amount (Hours × Rate). Calculate total hours (should be ~47.5) and total amount (should be ~$3,685). Create per-client summaries showing TechStart, GreenLeaf Co, and MarketPro totals. Note: GreenLeaf has a $1,200 budget cap. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
